735270101.text: I never imagined that you two would follow the sound of the broadcast here, especially after being warned!

735270102.text: Pardon me, but this attraction isn't officially open to the public yet. Please wait a few minutes for me to make some final adjustments...

735270105.text: Paimon heard words that sounded super scary! Water cannons! Must be that huge thing over there...

735270106.text: Whoa, it's scary just to look at!

735270107.text: Just what are you trying to do here!? We won't let you get away with it!

735270109.text: I'm Chatillon, head of project "Spino Blaster"! This project simulates naval battles, but much more fun and casual!

735270110.text: "Spino Blaster" is approved by Lady Idyia, so you know it's safe!

735270111.text: If you wish to verify the truth of that, please see this document signed by Lady Idyia herself.

735270112.text: The suspicious engineer offers proof in the form of official documents written in obtuse legalese, all with Idyia's distinct signature.\nThe margins even contain a few remarks and well-wishes from Idyia in her inimitable style...

735270113.text: So it's a project approved by Idyia... you scared us half to death!

735270114.text: So, what's the deal with the water cannons?

735270115.text: That's just a simplified nickname! Its full name is so long that I'm pretty sure most people would go for something shorter based on its appearance.

735270116.text: Anyway, its water bullets are completely harmless! At most, they might soak the guests standing near their target.

735270117.text: Some guests enjoy the sudden coolness from being splashed, but some hate how their clothes stick to their body afterward, and we don't want anyone to have a bad experience!

735270118.text: So if possible, I would like to post warning signs around the area.

735270119.text: Paimon didn't think you were so considerate, that's a great idea!

735279901.text: Attention, visitors below! Attention, visitors below! You are in water cannon range and are at risk of being hit. Please vacate the zone immediately!

735279902.text: Was that a warning? And did he say "water cannon"...? That doesn't sound good!

735279903.text: The broadcast came from over there. Let's see what's going on!
